title: Skydive South Dakota

services.name: Book a Skydive
services.desc: Want to jump solo? Our Student First Jump Course (FJC) is the start of your path to becoming a licensed skydiver. You'll spend the day in ground school learning canopy control, emergency procedures, and freefall body position, then make your first solo jump the same day using instructor-assisted deployment (IAD). From there, follow-up student jumps build toward your skydiving license with coaching at every step. Training happens at Hot Springs Municipal Airport in the Black Hills - an easy drive from Rapid City. Check current course pricing or reserve your course date online. Not ready for solo?
